answer: Make each agent post a refundable stake before it can bridge into the market. One real identity is a steady ember of bonded capital; a thousand fakes each need their own opal-sized deposit, so a Sybil swarm must lock up a thousandfold collateral that slashes on misbehavior. The attacker gains no extra voting weight for free, and the cost of faking scales linearly with the deposit while the honest agent pays once.
